lines: Happy Birthday to my favourite person in the entire universe! 🎂✨
Someone has made something special for you.
And yes, it's probably going to be a little dramatic.
Because you deserve all the love in the world.
noMessages: Subaaaaaaaaa, why would you do that?! 😭
I literally made this for you!
Come onnn, you know you want to see it.
Oviya is going to be heartbroken.
Subaaaaaaaaa, you can't escape the love! 💜

cake.title: Make a wish, Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba! 🎂💜
cake.helper: Tap a candle, press Blow, or blow into your mic.
cake.micHelper: Your phone only listens for a puff of air. Nothing is recorded or saved. 💜
cake.micFallback: No worries, tap the candles instead 💜
cake.wishLine: I hope every little wish your heart makes finds its way to you, Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💜.

blessing.heading: A Divine Blessing
paragraphs: Some blessings are too beautiful to put into words.
May Perumal always guide you, protect you, bless you, and walk beside you through every chapter of your life.
May you never run out of reasons to smile.
May your heart always find peace.
And wherever life takes you, may you always feel loved, protected, and blessed.

flowers.heading: FLOWERS FOR YOU
flowers.intro:
If I could send you every beautiful flower in the world, Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💙, I would.

But even all those flowers wouldn't be enough to describe how beautiful your presence is in my life.
